opportunities.title: Sendiee Workflow Automation Specialist
opportunities.description: I need an experienced automation pro to build a complete onboarding flow inside Sendiee. The goal is simple: when a new user signs up, everything that normally takes me hours should now happen instantly and without errors. Here’s what the engagement looks like: • Map the current onboarding sequence step-by-step, then recreate it inside Sendiee using the platform’s triggers, conditional logic and message scheduler. • Configure all messages, tasks and data hand-offs so the user receives the right information at the right time, and our team is notified only when human input is truly required. • Test each branch thoroughly, fix edge-cases, and document the setup so anyone on my team can maintain or extend it later. Acceptance criteria • A new test user moves from sign-up to “fully onboarded” with zero manual intervention. • All automated messages send from Sendiee on schedule and with correct personalisation fields. • A short PDF or shared doc describes the workflow, key settings and any API keys or webhooks used. Our priority is Sendiee, but if you’ve connected workflows to Google Workspace, Microsoft Office 365 or Slack before, that versatility will come in handy as we scale. Everything will be handled remotely; clear, timely communication is essential. If you’ve built similar process automations and can hit the ground running, I’d love to see a concise outline of how you’d tackle this and a link to a past project that proves you can deliver.

opportunities.title: Freelancer de Prospección Comercial B2b para Plataforma Saas Ordamy
opportunities.description: BIGSO Labs, una empresa de tecnología que desarrolla soluciones de software para negocios, busca un freelancer de prospección comercial B2B. El objetivo es conseguir nuevos clientes y desarrollar un proceso de adquisición comercial sostenible para Ordamy, una plataforma SaaS de gestión de órdenes de trabajo, clientes, productos, egresos y procesos operativos. Responsabilidades: - Identificar empresas potenciales, especialmente en los sectores de publicidad, impresión, diseño gráfico y relacionados. - Investigar mercados y construir bases de datos de prospectos. - Identificar responsables de toma de decisiones dentro de las empresas objetivo. - Contactar empresas utilizando canales como LinkedIn, WhatsApp y correo electrónico. - Realizar seguimiento, calificar oportunidades y agendar reuniones comerciales. - Registrar la actividad comercial y presentar informes de resultados. Las demostraciones de Ordamy y el cierre de las ventas se realizarán en conjunto con nuestro equipo interno. Perfil requerido: - Experiencia comprobada en prospección comercial B2B, generación de leads o ventas consultivas. - Habilidades de comunicación efectivas, autonomía y una fuerte orientación a resultados. - Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de negocio y contactar a decisores clave. - Se valorará positivamente la experiencia en la comercialización de software Saas, erp, crm o soluciones tecnológicas similares. Modalidad y compensación: El proyecto iniciará con una prueba piloto de seis semanas, en modalidad freelance y remota, con posibilidad de continuidad a largo plazo según los resultados obtenidos. La compensación propuesta incluye un pago base más bonificaciones por cada nuevo cliente que se convierta en cliente pago. Estamos abiertos a evaluar propuestas de acuerdo con la experiencia y metodología del candidato. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Comercial / Vendedor Tamaño del proyecto: Pequeño

opportunities.title: AI Agents for School Automation
opportunities.description: I’m building a cloud-based platform that lets schools and colleges hand off routine academic and administrative work to practical AI agents. The first release will centre on AI agents and, more specifically, data-analysis agents that can crunch institutional data and surface insights educators can act on immediately. Here is what I need from you: • Architect and code the core agent framework so multiple institutions can be onboarded under one roof without any data leakage. • Train and fine-tune the data-analysis agents to ingest grades, attendance records, and other common SIS/LMS exports, then return clear dashboards or API responses that teachers, administrators, and management can use day-to-day. • Wrap everything in an intuitive web interface (or expose a clean REST/GraphQL layer) so non-technical staff can trigger, monitor, and interpret each agent’s output with minimal hand-holding. • Provide deployment scripts, unit tests, and concise documentation so future agents—for example chatbots or scheduling assistants—can be plugged in effortlessly. I’m tech-agnostic on the exact stack, though Python with scalable frameworks such as FastAPI, LangChain, and either TensorFlow or PyTorch for model work would be ideal. Please outline your proposed approach, key milestones, and any similar projects you’ve shipped. I’m ready to move quickly once the right fit is found.

opportunities.title: LinkedIn Team Management Bot
opportunities.description: I need an automation bot that can handle day-to-day LinkedIn activity for my whole team. The core functions are straightforward: automatically post scheduled updates, send connection requests, and reply with simple templated messages whenever someone writes back. These same actions should run seamlessly across every team member’s account—no individual tweaks or custom workflows are required. A cloud-based or lightweight desktop solution is fine as long as it stays within LinkedIn’s usage policies and rotates safely through multiple profiles without triggering restrictions. Ideally the bot logs each action so I can review activity per user and pause or resume accounts as needed. If you usually work with Python, Node, Selenium, or the LinkedIn API, let me know which stack you prefer; I’m flexible on the tech as long as the final tool is reliable and easy to hand over. Deliverables: • Installable or hosted bot with a simple UI or config file for adding/removing team accounts • Scheduling logic for daily posts, batch connection requests, and instant message replies • Basic activity log export (CSV or similar) Once you’ve built and tested everything, walk me through setup so I can run it independently. Feel free to share examples of similar LinkedIn automation you’ve completed—seeing past work will help me choose the right partner for this project.

opportunities.title: AI Urban Redevelopment Simulator
opportunities.description: Project Title: AI Visual Director & Simulation Lead for Major U.S. Urban Redevelopment Initiative Project Overview: We are launching a transformative urban redevelopment initiative spanning 8 acres of vacant land in the United States, converting underutilized space into a modern, economically catalytic, community‑centered district. The project includes mixed‑use development, mobility upgrades, green infrastructure, civic amenities, and long‑term economic revitalization. To communicate this future vision to residents, investors, government officials, and media, we are seeking a world‑class AI Visual Director capable of producing a unified visual identity, cinematic redevelopment storytelling, and interactive, data‑driven simulations that show how the district will evolve over time. This is a leadership‑level creative role requiring mastery of AI visual tools, architectural visualization, simulation engines, and narrative design for large‑scale redevelopment. Role Summary: The AI Visual Director will design and produce a complete visual ecosystem for the redevelopment project. This includes AI‑generated imagery, cinematic sequences, master‑plan visuals, interactive simulations, branding elements, and presentation assets. You will translate planning concepts into compelling visual narratives and build a dynamic, data‑grounded model of the district’s future. Key Responsibilities: Visual Identity & Storytelling Develop a cohesive visual master plan for the 8‑acre redevelopment site. Produce AI‑generated architectural concepts, streetscapes, public spaces, mobility corridors, and green infrastructure. Create cinematic sequences using Runway, Pika, Midjourney, Stable Video, or similar tools. Design branding‑aligned visual identity (color system, typography, iconography). Generate high‑resolution renderings, aerial perspectives, and future‑state environmental visuals. Interactive Simulation & Modeling Build a future‑state simulation of the district—street by street, block by block. Integrate city‑planning PDFs, live traffic feeds (API access), and recent satellite imagery into a unified visual model. Model transportation flows, upgraded buildings/infrastructure, and activation of new public spaces. Deliver an interactive prototype (web or desktop) allowing stakeholders to toggle scenarios and timeframes. Incorporate explainable AI elements showing how data drives each visual change. Collaboration & Technical Delivery Work closely with planning, engineering, and development teams to ensure visual accuracy. Provide reproducible pipelines, prompt workflows, and source files. Produce presentation‑ready visuals for community meetings, investor decks, and municipal briefings. Required Expertise: Advanced proficiency in AI visual generation (Runway Gen‑2, Pika, Midjourney V6, Stable Diffusion, Sora‑style workflows). Strong background in architectural visualization, urban design imagery, or real‑estate development visuals. Experience with large‑environment or city‑scale simulations using Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender, Houdini, or GIS‑enabled engines. Ability to interpret zoning, planning, and redevelopment concepts into visual form. Portfolio demonstrating high‑end AI visual direction and complex environment creation. Strong understanding of branding, narrative pacing, and public‑facing visual communication. Key Deliverables: Complete AI Visual Identity Package for the redevelopment initiative. 3–5 minute cinematic redevelopment video, plus 30s/60s/90s social cuts. 20–40 AI‑generated renderings (architectural, aerial, streetscape, public space). Interactive simulation prototype (web or desktop) with scenario toggles. Methodology document enabling in‑house planners to extend the model. Prompt workflows + reproducible pipelines. Optional: animated overlays, data visualizations, phasing graphics. Acceptance Criteria: Simulations must accurately reflect provided planning parameters and real‑time traffic metrics. Transport, buildings, and public‑space layers must be independently switchable. Visual performance: smooth 60 fps playback on a mid‑range GPU. Cinematic sequences must align with branding and narrative direction. All visuals must be high‑resolution and presentation‑ready. opportunities.title: Soporte WhatsApp Nocturno en Vivo
opportunities.description: Busco a una persona que pueda encargarse de responder los mensajes de mis clientes por WhatsApp Business en tiempo real, de 18:00 h a 23:00 h cada día. Lo que necesito: • Atención personalizada en vivo: no son respuestas automáticas. Quiero que cada cliente sienta que habla con un ser humano que entiende su consulta al momento. • Tono neutro y directo: respuestas claras, sin rodeos, manteniendo siempre un trato cordial. • Dominio de WhatsApp Business: uso de etiquetas, respuestas rápidas y notas internas para que el historial de cada cliente quede bien organizado. • Reporte breve al final del turno: un resumen de preguntas frecuentes, incidencias resueltas y temas pendientes, para que al día siguiente podamos darles seguimiento. Valoraré experiencia previa en soporte por chat, buena ortografía y velocidad de respuesta. Si puedes comenzar pronto y comprometerte de manera continua, me encantará saber más sobre tu experiencia.

opportunities.description: **Project Title: Affiliate Marketers Required to Sell DEVKUND DHOOP – Commission on Every Sale** **Project Description:** We are looking for experienced affiliate marketers to promote and sell our product, **DEVKUND DHOOP**, made from cow dung, under the brand KD Enterprises. Our mission is to promote traditional Indian products, support Gau Seva, and create awareness about the useful value of cow dung. **What We Need:** * Affiliate marketers who can generate genuine online sales. * Experience in affiliate marketing, social media marketing, influencer marketing, or e-commerce promotion. * Ability to promote products through Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, blogs, or other suitable channels. * A focus on genuine customers and measurable sales. **Commission & Payment:** * Commission will be paid on every verified sale. * Commission structure will be discussed and finalized based on the marketing strategy. * We are interested in building a long-term partnership with good-performing affiliates. **About Our Product:** * Brand: DEVKUND DHOOP * Business: KD Enterprises * Product: Cow dung dhoop cones * Target customers: People interested in पूजा, spirituality, traditional Indian products, and Gau Seva. **Please Include in Your Proposal:** 1. Your affiliate marketing experience. 2. Which platforms you will use to promote our product. 3. Your proposed commission per sale. 4. How you will generate sales and track orders. 5. Examples of previous results, if available. We prefer performance-based partnerships and are looking for affiliates who can help us grow our brand across India. If you can generate genuine sales, we would love to work with you! Thank you.

opportunities.title: Animación 3D de Vivienda Moderna -- 2
opportunities.description: Quiero transformar mi proyecto residencial en una animación 3D fluida y atractiva que muestre cada detalle de un diseño de estilo moderno. La vivienda ya está modelada; lo que necesito ahora es una secuencia animada que recorra todos los espacios — sala de estar, cocina, dormitorio principal y el resto de la casa — con una narrativa visual que permita apreciar materiales, iluminación y distribución. Busco a alguien que se mueva con soltura en herramientas como 3ds Max, Blender o similares, y que domine motores de render como V-Ray, Corona o Lumion para lograr acabados realistas. Me interesa un resultado cinematográfico, con transiciones suaves, luz natural convincente y algún detalle de animación de mobiliario o accesorios para dar vida al ambiente. Entregables clave: • Video final en resolución Full HD (idealmente también versión 4K) • Archivo de proyecto editable o set de fotogramas si es necesario realizar ajustes posteriores • Una captura fija de cada estancia principal para material promocional Aprecio la comunicación clara durante el proceso: storyboard o previz inicial, un primer corte para feedback y la versión final con ajustes de color y música ambiental ligera. Si tienes ejemplos de recorridos virtuales previos, enlázalos en tu propuesta; será un plus para decidir.

opportunities.title: Formulación de Proyecto Mga: Adquisición de Ambulancia 4x4 para Res...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional experto en la formulación de proyectos de inversión pública en Colombia, con dominio de la Metodología General Ajustada (MGA Web del DNP). El objetivo principal es estructurar y formular de manera integral un proyecto de inversión para la adquisición de una ambulancia de Transporte Asistencial Básico (TAB), con chasis campero 4x4 (tipo Toyota de alta penetración). Este vehículo será destinado a garantizar la atención y traslado de urgencias en salud para las comunidades del Resguardo Indígena Iroka, ubicado en la Serranía del Perijá, departamento del Cesar. El proyecto debe ser formulado en estricto cumplimiento con la normativa y los estándares exigidos por el Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social de Colombia, incluyendo la norma técnica NTC 3729 y la Resolución 3100 de 2019, que rigen la habilitación de servicios y la viabilidad técnica de proyectos de transporte asistencial. opportunities.title: Animación 3D de Vivienda Moderna
opportunities.description: Quiero transformar mi proyecto residencial en una animación 3D fluida y atractiva que muestre cada detalle de un diseño de estilo moderno. La vivienda ya está modelada; lo que necesito ahora es una secuencia animada que recorra todos los espacios — sala de estar, cocina, dormitorio principal y el resto de la casa — con una narrativa visual que permita apreciar materiales, iluminación y distribución. Busco a alguien que se mueva con soltura en herramientas como 3ds Max, Blender o similares, y que domine motores de render como V-Ray, Corona o Lumion para lograr acabados realistas. Me interesa un resultado cinematográfico, con transiciones suaves, luz natural convincente y algún detalle de animación de mobiliario o accesorios para dar vida al ambiente. Entregables clave: • Video final en resolución Full HD (idealmente también versión 4K) • Archivo de proyecto editable o set de fotogramas si es necesario realizar ajustes posteriores • Una captura fija de cada estancia principal para material promocional Aprecio la comunicación clara durante el proceso: storyboard o previz inicial, un primer corte para feedback y la versión final con ajustes de color y música ambiental ligera. Si tienes ejemplos de recorridos virtuales previos, enlázalos en tu propuesta; será un plus para decidir.

I need a carousel skill, which would basically create a carousel post for me based on the viral topic so it goes viral for my Instagram. It should have good formatting and everything, have my face, and be a knowledgeable post that can basically go viral in the real estate niche or get more views as a local carousel post. 3. I will give a Google Sheet, which will be updated every day through my WhatsApp CRM, and it will keep having more and more leads. There will be a category in that sheet where we want AI to be broadcasting based on the requirements so it can nurture and make that client warm and active again. We want to use a Twilio number to send a broadcast and create a proper nurturing process for those leads. This is the third thing that I need and it should be done through my Claude. opportunities.title: Rezoning & Plat Design Engineer Needed
opportunities.description: I’m preparing a residential parcel that is currently improved with a single-family home for a full change of land use and need a licensed civil engineer who can carry the project from conceptual site plan through to a recordable plat. Your work will anchor my rezoning application, so I’m looking for someone who already understands local submittal standards, survey control, and the sequencing of community development review. What I will supply: the legal description, survey, city checklists, and my target zoning classification. What I need from you: • A code-compliant preliminary site layout that supports the new land-use request • A complete set of civil sheets (grading, drainage, utilities, and access) ready for the planning department’s first round of comments • The subdivision or lot-split plat drafted to the recorder’s requirements, including closures and signature blocks • Coordination notes or mark-ups for any external consultants (traffic, geotech) if they become necessary • A short response matrix addressing staff comments until we secure approval All files should be delivered in both PDF and the original CAD format (Civil 3D preferred). Stamp and license details must match jurisdictional rules; I’ll cover application fees and municipal prints once the plans are finalized. If you have recent examples of successful residential-to-other-use rezonings and plats, let me know when you bid—I’m moving quickly on this and want to file the first package within three weeks.

opportunities.title: Puebla - Evaluar atención y servicio de manera presencial -- 3
opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar una cotización de manera presencial en una empresa asignada por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Puebla, preferentemente cerca de zona Angelopolis. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Gracias.

opportunities.title: Asistente Virtual Bilingüe Experto
opportunities.description: Busco un asistente virtual con nivel experto que se encargue de tres frentes clave dentro de mi negocio: • Atención al cliente – Responder consultas por correo y chat, gestionar tickets y mantener un tono cordial y resolutivo tanto en español como en inglés. • Gestión de correos – Organizar la bandeja de entrada, filtrar mensajes prioritarios, redactar respuestas, programar seguimientos y archivar correos según etiquetas predeterminadas. • Investigación en línea – Recopilar datos sobre competidores, oportunidades de mercado y mejores prácticas, presentándome resúmenes claros y fuentes verificables. Trabajo principalmente con Gmail, Google Workspace, hojas de cálculo y un CRM tipo HubSpot; confío en que te desenvuelvas fluidamente en herramientas similares. Necesito: – Disponibilidad de lunes a viernes en horario latinoamericano. – Tiempo de respuesta máximo de 2 horas en consultas internas. – Un breve informe semanal con métricas de tickets cerrados, correos gestionados y hallazgos de investigación. Si dominas la comunicación bilingüe, eres proactivo y ya manejas flujos de atención al cliente de alto volumen, estarás en tu zona de confort. Cuéntame tu experiencia, tus casos de éxito y la metodología que seguirías para arrancar cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Infrastructure BIM Modeling in Revit
opportunities.description: I am developing an infrastructure project and need a comprehensive BIM model built entirely in Autodesk Revit. The scope covers three key areas: • Site layout • Utilities (all underground and above-ground services) • Structural elements for the civil works I’m looking for a detailed-design level model that is ready for coordination with other disciplines and can serve as the basis for construction documentation later on. All geometry, families, and parameters should follow standard Revit best practices so clash detection and quantity take-offs run smoothly in Navisworks or comparable tools. Deliverables: 1. Revit model (.rvt) reflecting the full site, utility networks, and structural framework at detailed-design accuracy. 2. Linked views and sheets that clearly show plans, sections, and 3D perspectives for each scope area. 3. An export in IFC or NWC format for collaboration. Please keep model organization tidy with consistent naming conventions, reusable families, and logical worksets. If you already have experience on infrastructure projects—roads, bridges, or utility corridors—highlight it when you respond.

opportunities.title: Low-Poly weapons
opportunities.description: Hi, I’m looking for a Low-Poly 3D Weapon Artist to create stylized, game-ready weapons and utility items for my project. The style should be similar to Synty Studios: clean low-poly geometry, readable silhouettes, and a polished stylized look. Please use Synty as a style reference only — no copied assets. Scope: • 8+ firearms: pistol, rifles, SMG, shotgun, etc. • One knife • Utility items: grenades, flashbangs, Molotovs, medkits, flashlights, tools, and similar equipment • Final asset count is not fixed yet; we will start with a small test batch and expand from there Requirements: • Low-poly / stylized, Synty-inspired visual direction • Clean, optimized topology and consistent proportions • Game-ready for Unity or Unreal Engine • FBX and/or glTF export • Correct scale, pivots, naming, and organized hierarchy • Assets should be rig-ready / riggable for future animations • Vertex colors, flat colors, or lightweight PBR materials Optional: If you can also provide weapon rigging and basic animations (idle, equip, fire, reload), please mention it and include the additional cost. Modeling-only artists are also welcome to apply. Please include: • Portfolio links, especially low-poly weapons or stylized assets • Your price per weapon/asset or package price • Estimated delivery time • Engine and software experience • Whether you can also rig/animate weapons Budget: Please include your own price in the proposal. I will first order a small test batch, for example 3–5 weapons, before continuing with the full asset pack. Please start your proposal with “WEAPON” so I know you read the full description.

opportunities.title: Representante Comercial para Software ERP Inmobiliario
opportunities.description: Buscamos socio comercial freelance para vender software ERP inmobiliario En Digitech Group Perú hemos desarrollado **Syncro, un ERP diseñado para empresas inmobiliarias**, que permite centralizar procesos administrativos y financieros, automatizar operaciones y tener mayor control del negocio. Estamos buscando un **representante comercial independiente** que nos ayude a conseguir nuevos clientes en Lima y otras ciudades del Perú. ¿Qué buscamos? - Experiencia en ventas B2B, preferiblemente de software, ERP o soluciones tecnológicas. - Capacidad para identificar inmobiliarias, contactar a sus gerentes y generar oportunidades comerciales. - Habilidad para presentar propuestas, hacer seguimiento y cerrar ventas. ¿Cómo trabajaremos? La modalidad es freelance y basada en resultados: **no hay una mensualidad fija; la remuneración será mediante comisiones por cada cliente que contrate Syncro y realice el pago correspondiente. Nosotros nos encargamos de las demostraciones técnicas, la implementación y el soporte del sistema. El socio comercial se enfoca en generar oportunidades y concretar las ventas. Si tienes experiencia comercial y te interesa trabajar con un producto tecnológico propio, nos gustaría conversar contigo. Para postular, envíanos tu experiencia en ventas B2B, los sectores con los que has trabajado y tu propuesta de comisión.

opportunities.title: Marketing video campaigners
opportunities.description: I want to turn my new single into a fully animated, AI-driven 3D music video that matches the track’s uplifting, energetic vibe. You’ll receive the mastered audio and lyrics right after kickoff and guide the project from rough storyboard through final render. Bright colour palettes, fluid camera moves and rhythm-synced cuts are essential; I’m after something that feels crafted for the song, not generic stock visuals. Please take care of modelling, animation, lighting, and compositing—whether you work in Blender, Unreal, Runway, Stable Diffusion, or your own pipeline is up to you. The final deliverable should be at least 1920×1080 in an easily playable format plus the source project files for archiving. When you respond, share two or three relevant examples of animated music videos you’ve created, mention the primary tools you’ll use, and outline your timeline to completion. I’m excited to see how you bring this track to life.

opportunities.title: Full-Time Medical Billing & Insurance Collections Specialist - Fixed Monthly Salary - Long-Term
opportunities.description: Full-Time Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Specialist - Remote Position: Full-Time, Long-Term Remote Monthly Salary: USD $400-600, depending on experience and competence Working Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday-Friday, with overlap during our local (EST/CST) business hours Location: Remote - Applicants from the Philippines, India, Pakistan, and other countries are welcome. ABOUT US We are an established, multidisciplinary private medical clinic in the Caribbean, offering family medicine, specialist consultations, advanced diagnostic imaging, physiotherapy, and other healthcare services. We are seeking a highly experienced, reliable, and detail-oriented Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to independently manage our medical billing operations, improve collections, and ensure accurate and timely insurance claim processing. This is a long-term opportunity for a proactive professional who takes ownership of their responsibilities, works independently, and delivers measurable results. We use a customized EMR and are developing an AI-assisted billing automation system to streamline our revenue cycle operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Medical Billing & Insurance Claims - Prepare, verify, submit, and track medical insurance claims. - Identify and resolve unsubmitted, rejected, denied, and unpaid claims. - Review CPT and ICD-10 coding accuracy and billing documentation. - Follow up directly with insurance companies regarding outstanding claims. - Manage claim corrections, resubmissions, and appeals. - Ensure claims comply with applicable local insurance requirements and reimbursement schedules. Payment Processing & Reconciliation - Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and insurance remittances. - Accurately post and reconcile insurance and patient payments in our EMR. - Identify missing payments, incorrect balances, duplicate charges, and other discrepancies. - Maintain accurate patient accounts and financial records. Accounts Receivable & Collections - Proactively pursue outstanding insurance and patient balances. - Contact insurers and patients professionally by phone, email, or approved messaging channels. - Investigate overdue accounts and resolve payment discrepancies. - Maintain accurate aging reports and follow-up records. - Prioritize collection activities that improve cash flow. Reporting & Accountability - Provide concise daily reports detailing claims submitted, payments received, collection activities, outstanding balances, and unresolved issues. - Maintain accurate documentation of completed work and follow-up activities. - Identify recurring billing problems and recommend improvements. - Work independently with minimal supervision while consistently meeting agreed performance targets. AI & Billing Automation Collaboration - Collaborate with our technical developer on an AI-assisted medical billing automation system. - Help identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation. - Test automated workflows and verify accuracy. - Assist with improving billing procedures and operational efficiency. Programming skills are not required. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Minimum 3 years of practical medical billing and revenue cycle management experience. - Proven experience with insurance claims, denials, EOBs, payment posting, and accounts receivable. - Familiarity with CPT and ICD-10 coding. - Experience using electronic medical record (EMR) or billing software. - Strong understanding of commercial/private medical insurance. - Excellent spoken and written English. - Proficiency in Microsoft Excel. - Strong attention to detail and financial accuracy. - Comfortable making insurance follow-up and patient collections calls. - Ability to work independently, proactively identify problems, and resolve them. - Reliable internet connection and a secure, confidential working environment. - Willingness to learn local insurance regulations, reimbursement schedules, and billing procedures. Experience with medical billing outside the United States is an advantage. COMPENSATION & WORKING ARRANGEMENT - Fixed monthly salary: USD $400-600, based on qualifications, experience, and demonstrated competence, with opportunity for a raise over time. - Full-time position, 40 hours per week. - Monday-Friday, with sufficient overlap during local (EST/CST) business hours. - Long-term opportunity for the right candidate. - Potential salary increases based on performance and demonstrated results. HOW TO APPLY To be considered, please answer ALL of the following questions: 1. How many years of hands-on medical billing experience do you have? 2. Which EMR or billing systems have you used? 3. Describe your experience with insurance claims, denied claims, payment reconciliation, and collections. 4. Have you worked with commercial/private health insurance companies? 5. How would you approach a backlog of overdue insurance claims and outstanding patient balances? 6. Are you comfortable contacting insurance companies and patients by telephone to resolve outstanding payments? 7. What is your expected monthly salary within our $400-600 USD range? 8. Can you commit to 40 hours per week with overlap during local (EST/CST) business hours? Important: Begin your proposal with the phrase "Medical Billing Specialist 2026" to demonstrate that you have carefully read the project description. We are looking for an experienced medical billing professional, not a general virtual assistant or someone with only basic data-entry experience. Accuracy, confidentiality, reliability, proactive communication, and measurable results are essential. Further details about our clinic will be shared with shortlisted candidates during the recruitment process.

opportunities.title: Photorealistic Satirical Rendering Needed
opportunities.description: I am commissioning a series of photorealistic, satirical renders that poke fun at contemporary issues. The very first scene should place Ghislaine Maxwell on a lush tropical island, guiding a young boy toward the unmistakable blue-and-white building that made the location notorious. The tone must be sharply realistic—no caricature or cartoon flair—so I expect skin pores, fabric texture, accurate tropical lighting, and convincing water reflections. In this inaugural piece, the viewer’s eye needs to land first on the characters’ facial expressions. Maxwell’s rehearsed composure contrasted with the boy’s tentative curiosity. I am flexible on the software you use (Blender with Cycles, 3ds Max + V-Ray, Octane, Unreal, or comparable high-end tools are all fine) as long as the final image is printable at poster size without visible noise or sampling artifacts. Deliverables • One 4K (or higher) still render in PNG or TIFF • The layered or native project file so I can revisit camera angles for future scenes I plan to expand the series once this first image hits the right satirical note, so your approach to lighting, composition, and file organization should make follow-up shots efficient. Let me know your estimated turnaround and any clarifying questions, and show me two or three portfolio pieces that prove you can blend realism with biting social commentary.

opportunities.title: Font Effects Developer Needed
opportunities.description: I'm looking for a developer with a good understanding on fonts and more specifically font effects and the type of font tools that would be effective to render them for a server-side solution to render fonts, for example either ttf files or open type files. here are the effects I need rendered, I need gradient either two color or three color, shadow, and stroke. STROKE: I need a stroke with three types of alignment, inside, Center and outside and the thickness by pixel DROP SHADOW: Generally speaking the drop shadow is like a 45° slanted going downhill with a level of opacity for example 75% of a solid black and two pixels or four pixels wide. GRADIENT: this particular item is a range of colors for example from Blue to White or red to Yellow that would be an example of a two color gradient, in some cases I need a three color gradient which will be something like red to orange to White. now when it comes to gradient it's possible that I can build the gradient into the font but that would require whatever class or Library you intend to use to support either COLRv1 or SVG mask layer. so actual gradients do not need to be applied if you're able to read the built-in gradient that's already provided on the font level. .Feel free to reach out so we can discuss the details of the project and it's important that you're able to understand English communication is important. see you online.

opportunities.title: Flat Composite Panel CAD Layout
opportunities.description: I need an accomplished AutoCAD technician with a solid mechanical-design background (10 + years) to create the geometric layout of flat composite panels destined for aerospace components. The task centres on translating my existing AutoCad files into detailed flat panel layout and mechanical design of attachment brackets for securing the composite panels to the aircraft. The drawings need to be clean, production-ready CAD files that accurately capture every cut-line, hole pattern and assembly datum. You will work exclusively in AutoCAD (any recent version is fine) and apply your deep understanding of flat panel geometry to ensure dimensional integrity, material-usage efficiency and straightforward manufacturability. I will supply all files containing baseline dimensions, stack-ups and laminate schedules and the criteria for creating flat panel geometry; your job is to turn that information into clear, fully-constrained drawings that will be acceptable to the U.S. government’s Aviation Command. Deliverables • DWG and DXF files of each panel outline, complete with layers clearly labelled for ply boundaries, trim, drill and reference points • A single PDF set for quick review and mark-up • A brief design note summarising any assumptions or critical tolerances Acceptance criteria • All geometry must close within ±0.1 mm of the provided envelope • Hole locations must align to the supplied coordinate table; any deviation flagged back before final issue • Files open error-free in AutoCAD and import cleanly into CATIA V5 If you have long-standing experience crafting flat composite panels and you are comfortable working to aerospace standards, I look forward to collaborating with you.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "I need an accomplished AutoCAD technician with a solid mechanical-design background (10 + years) to create the geometric layout of flat composite panels destined for aerospace components. The task centres on translating my existing AutoCad files into detailed flat panel layout and mechanical design of attachment brackets for securing the composite panels to the aircraft. The drawings need to be clean, production-ready CAD files that accurately capture every cut-line, hole pattern and assembly datum. You will work exclusively in AutoCAD (any recent version is fine) and apply your deep understanding of flat panel geometry to ensure dimensional integrity, material-usage efficiency and straightforward manufacturability. I will supply all files containing baseline dimensions, stack-ups and laminate schedules and the criteria for creating flat panel geometry; your job is to turn that information into clear, fully-constrained drawings that will be acceptable to the U.S. government’s Aviation Command. Deliverables • DWG and DXF files of each panel outline, complete with layers clearly labelled for ply boundaries, trim, drill and reference points • A single PDF set for quick review and mark-up • A brief design note summarising any assumptions or critical tolerances Acceptance criteria • All geometry must close within ±0.1 mm of the provided envelope • Hole locations must align to the supplied coordinate table; any deviation flagged back before final issue • Files open error-free in AutoCAD and import cleanly into CATIA V5 If you have long-standing experience crafting flat composite panels and you are comfortable working to aerospace standards, I look forward to collaborating with you."

opportunities.title: Bot WhatsApp con envío de correos
opportunities.description: Necesito un bot que se instale en mi línea de WhatsApp Business y actúe como primer punto de atención al cliente. Su trabajo será conversar de forma natural, responder las preguntas más frecuentes y ofrecer información detallada sobre nuestros productos y servicios. Cuando el cliente complete un formulario dentro del chat, el bot debe tomar ese documento, generar un correo personalizado y enviarlo automáticamente a la dirección que corresponda; todo esto sin intervención humana, salvo en casos que yo mismo indique. Espero recibir un flujo totalmente configurado (Webhook, WhatsApp Business API o Twilio, según tu preferencia) y un panel sencillo para ajustar respuestas, plantillas de correo y credenciales SMTP. El proyecto queda completo cuando: • el bot responde FAQs y consultas de catálogo sin errores, • captura el formulario en PDF/HTML, lo adjunta y envía el correo al destinatario correcto, • guarda cada interacción en un simple dashboard o en Google Sheets para seguimiento. Si dominas Python, Node.js o herramientas no-code que integren ambas funciones, dime cómo lo harás y el tiempo estimado. Quiero algo estable, fácil de mantener y, sobre todo, listo para usar.

opportunities.title: Realistic Porch 3D Rendering
opportunities.description: I already have an AI-generated concept, a footprint sketch, and a full set of site photos. What I need now is one polished, high-resolution rendering that shows the proposed porch as it will actually be built. Accuracy of the porch design—dimensions, roof pitch, trim, railing, and column placement—is the single most important factor. The surrounding house, grading, and landscaping should read naturally in the scene, but photoreal lighting and shadows are only required insofar as they help the structure look believable to a homeowner and building inspector. You are free to work in SketchUp, Revit, Blender, or another professional tool; just export the final still as a high-quality image and, if possible, include the editable source file. I can share the written scope of work for extra clarity once we start. If you have a track record creating realistic residential renderings and can turn this around quickly, I look forward to seeing your approach and previous samples.

opportunities.title: Upgrade openHAB 2 to 5 on raspberry pi device for home automation
opportunities.description: I am running a fairly mature openHAB 2.x installation and I’m ready to move it to the current 3.x release. The goal is a seamless, zero-data-loss migration that keeps my existing setup intact while letting me take advantage of the new, cleaner user interface. What absolutely must survive the process are the bindings and add-ons I already rely on, along with my customized sitemap/HABPanel layouts and any other UI tweaks. If a binding has a newer 3.x equivalent, I’d like it transitioned rather than replaced. I will handle basic backups beforehand, but I’m looking for someone who can: • Install or guide the installation of openHAB 3.x on the same Linux host (or suggest a smoother path if you think a parallel install plus swap-over is safer). • Migrate the userdata and conf folders, resolving any breaking-change syntax issues in rules or things files. • Verify that every existing binding comes back online and that all dashboards load correctly. • Walk me through final checks so I can confirm the enhanced UI is fully operational and all items, things, and scenes behave as before. Acceptance criteria are simple: the system boots into openHAB 3.x with no errors in the log, each previously installed binding shows a healthy state, and my user interface looks and functions just as it did—only better. If you’ve already moved other users from 2.x to 3.x and know the common migration pitfalls, your experience will be invaluable here.

Success will be measured by a steady rise in qualified leads at an efficient CPL, so I’m counting on a data-driven approach, smart use of Google’s automation, and transparent reporting. If you have a proven track record running lead gen campaigns on Google Ads and you’re comfortable with both business and consumer audiences, let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Excel Payment Reconciliation Automation
opportunities.description: I work with two separate Excel exports every day. • Sheet A lists every customer invoice that was paid by credit card, ACH, or an online bank payment. • Sheet B shows the exact dollar amount that actually sent to the bank for each invoice. What I need is a single, formula-driven workbook where I can simply paste those two raw tables and instantly see: – which invoice numbers line up, – whether the payment amounts and dates agree, and – which payment method (ACH, credit card, or bank account draft) was used. The workflow I imagine: 1. Paste Sheet A in Tab 1 and Sheet B in Tab 2. 2. Tab 3 automatically performs the reconciliation, flagging perfect matches, partial matches (amount or date off), and any missing items from either side. 3. A clear summary totals the matched and unmatched dollar values so I can hand it straight to accounting or spot issues at a glance. Feel free to build this with the lookup or pivot techniques you prefer—VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, or even a lightweight macro—so long as it remains easy for a non-technical user to maintain and expand. Consistent naming, tidy formulas, and comments explaining any key logic will be appreciated. When we’re done I should be able to paste fresh data, hit Refresh (or a single macro button), and walk away with an accurate reconciliation in seconds.

opportunities.title: Presentación PowerPoint Creativa Constructora
opportunities.description: Quiero plasmar los servicios de mi empresa constructora en una presentación de alta resolución, íntegramente en PowerPoint, con un enfoque creativo y muy visual. El objetivo es que cada diapositiva hable por sí sola, combinando imágenes de calidad con textos claros para destacar: • Nuestros proyectos realizados (antes-después, datos clave, fotografías originales). • El portafolio de servicios que ofrecemos, mostrados de forma ordenada y atractiva. Entregaré logotipo, paleta de colores y la información base; necesito que los transformes en un archivo .pptx editable, formato 16:9, listo para proyectar o exportar a PDF sin pérdida de nitidez. Acepto sugerencias de animaciones sutiles o iconografía si refuerzan la narrativa, pero la estética general debe mantenerse limpia, moderna y coherente con la marca. Al finalizar, espero: 1. Presentación final en .pptx (alta resolución). 2. Versión PDF optimizada para enviar por correo. 3. Recursos gráficos originales utilizados, por si requiero ajustes posteriores. Si tienes portafolio en trabajos similares, compártelo para evaluar rápidamente el estilo.

opportunities.title: Videos automatizados de finanzas
opportunities.description: Quiero convertir la producción de mis tutoriales de finanzas para YouTube en un proceso casi automático. El objetivo es disponer de un flujo de trabajo que, a partir de un guion o esquema, genere un video terminado con animaciones explicativas que ilustren conceptos como presupuestos, inversiones y ahorro. Busco algo que mantenga un estilo limpio, claro y consistente entre episodio y episodio. Lo que necesito de ti: • Diseñar o recomendar la combinación de herramientas (p. ej., generadores de voz, editores de video, scripts en Python, After Effects, etc.) que mejor se ajuste a la automatización. • Crear una plantilla base que incluya: introducción, secciones con transiciones suaves y la inserción automática de las animaciones explicativas. • Entregar un ejemplo funcional (un video de muestra de 2-3 min) para validar que todo el proceso va de principio a fin sin intervención manual extensa. • Documentar paso a paso cómo replicar el flujo para futuros tutoriales. Valoraré experiencia previa en canales educativos, manejo de datos financieros y cualquier demo que demuestre automatización real. Si tienes ideas adicionales para optimizar tiempos o añadir métricas de rendimiento, coméntamelo.

opportunities.title: Spanish Dog Training Pads Packaging
opportunities.description: Necesito que nuestro nuevo paquete de pads entrenadores para perros luzca tan confiable como el producto mismo. El trabajo abarca dos presentaciones distintas, pero ambas deben compartir la misma línea visual premium y un estilo moderno y limpio que transmita calidad, higiene y confianza. Toda la información irá en español y, al frente, a los lados y al reverso del empaque, quiero que destaquen claramente el logotipo de la marca, los beneficios principales, el tamaño / cantidad de unidades, modo de uso, y la información de la empresa . Yo aportaré la paleta cromática oficial, así que solo tendrás que aplicarla de forma coherente y atractiva. Espero de ti: • Arte final listo para imprenta (AI + PDF con sangrados y troqueles). • Mockups realistas en 3D que permitan ver el empaque terminado desde varios ángulos. • Organización clara del layout: marca, tamaño, cantidad, beneficios y modo de uso. Experiencia previa en diseño de packaging es indispensable; adjunta ejemplos de trabajos similares en tu propuesta y comienza tu mensaje con la palabra “PACKAGING” para saber que leíste todo. Herramientas que suelo manejar: Adobe Illustrator para el arte y cualquier software de mockup 3D que prefieras (Dimension, Blender, Cinema 4D, etc.). Entrego de inmediato las medidas exactas y el manual de color una vez acordemos la colaboración.

opportunities.title: Estrategia Retail Tienda Histórica
opportunities.description: Poseo una tienda con 61 años de historia que, a pesar de haber sido remodelada y duplicar la capacidad de exhibición, continúa sufriendo por bajas ventas. Busco a un profesional con experiencia demostrada en retail y en la creación de modelos de negocio que me acompañe a reposicionarla y devolverla a la rentabilidad. Situación actual • Local totalmente renovado, mayor espacio de sala de ventas. • Principal problema financiero: bajas ventas sostenidas. • Público objetivo: campesinos, agricultores, pequeños productores y transeúntes de la zona rural. • Nueva línea prevista: productos complementarios de veterinaria, agricultura y formato minisúper. Tienda ubicada en un lugar con alto tráfico de personas (cerca de la terminal de transporte de la ciudad) Tienda con una marca reconocida Lo que necesito de tu parte 1. Diagnóstico inicial apoyado en métricas de retail (tráfico, ticket promedio, GMROI). 2. Rediseño del modelo de negocio que defina surtido óptimo y mezcla de categorías, incluyendo la nueva propuesta veterinaria-agrícola. 3. Estrategia de precios, layout y experiencia en tienda pensando en mi público rural. 4. Plan de marketing integral (offline y digital) con acciones de lanzamiento y calendario de campañas. 5. Proyección financiera que muestre punto de equilibrio y escenarios de crecimiento. 6. Indicadores clave y hoja de ruta de implementación para los primeros 12 meses. Valoro entregables claros, análisis sustentado en datos y recomendaciones accionables. Si has liderado procesos de turnaround o reposicionamiento en retail, especialmente en mercados rurales o especializados, cuéntame tu experiencia: será decisivo para seleccionar al experto adecuado.

opportunities.title: Integración Shopify Plus–Si-Nube
opportunities.description: Quiero convertir Shopify Plus en la plataforma central de mi operación: ahí los vendedores y clientes deberán cotizar productos y generar sus pedidos, mientras que toda la información se sincroniza en tiempo real con nuestro ERP Si-Nube. Lo que necesito de ti: • Configurar una integración bidireccional Shopify Plus ↔ Si-Nube con sincronización de datos en tiempo real (productos, precios, clientes, estatus de pedido). • Implementar dentro de Shopify Plus dos flujos clave: cotización de productos y levantamiento de pedidos. Ya cuento con funcionalidades específicas en mente; al iniciar el proyecto te compartiré el detalle para que puedas desarrollarlas o parametrizarlas. • Garantizar que la información fluya sin errores ni duplicados y quede lista para facturación y seguimiento desde el ERP. • Documentar la solución y capacitar brevemente a mi equipo para que pueda operar y escalar el sistema. Valoro la experiencia demostrable en Shopify Plus, APIs, webhooks y, de preferencia, proyectos previos con ERPs latinoamericanos. Si dominas Si-Nube o has realizado integraciones similares, mejor aún. Espero tu propuesta con tiempos estimados y tu enfoque técnico.

opportunities.title: Gestión Documental ISO SharePoint
opportunities.description: Quiero crear una aplicación en SharePoint que me ayude a cumplir los requisitos de la norma ISO mediante una gestión de documentos ágil y segura. El foco principal es la Gestión de documentos y, dentro de ella, necesito que la solución incorpore: • Control de versiones para asegurar la trazabilidad completa de cada archivo. • Permisos de acceso granulares que faciliten aprobaciones y ediciones diferenciadas por rol. • Plantillas de documentos pre-configuradas para estandarizar formatos y metadatos. Aún no he definido si el acceso estará limitado a grupos o roles concretos, por lo que agradeceré tu orientación sobre las mejores prácticas en SharePoint Online, así como la posible integración con Azure AD o Microsoft 365 grupos. Lo que espero recibir: 1. Estructura del sitio o colección de sitios orientada a ISO (bibliotecas, columnas, flujos de aprobación). 2. Configuración de versiones, permisos y plantillas lista para usarse. 3. Documentación breve con capturas donde se explique cómo mantener y escalar la solución. 4. Recomendaciones para futuras automatizaciones con Power Automate si fuese necesario. Si ya has implementado soluciones similares, cuéntame brevemente tu enfoque y el tiempo estimado. Busco una implementación clara, replicable y bien documentada.

opportunities.title: Desarrollador Full Stack Senior para Sitios Web y Crm Personalizados
opportunities.description: Buscamos un Desarrollador Full Stack Senior con amplia experiencia en programación web, diseño ux/ui y desarrollo de crm personalizados. Este profesional será clave para transformar ideas de negocio en plataformas digitales completas, modernas, intuitivas, funcionales y escalables, participando desde la conceptualización hasta la implementación. El proyecto incluye el desarrollo de 4 plataformas: dos sitios web corporativos modernos y responsive con funcionalidades específicas, y dos CRM personalizados para la gestión comercial, contactos, clientes, procesos internos y automatizaciones. Se requiere la integración entre las webs y sus respectivos CRM para la captación de leads, administración de información y seguimiento, además de la incorporación de herramientas de inteligencia artificial, integraciones externas y funcionalidades avanzadas. Las responsabilidades abarcan comprender nuestras necesidades, proponer soluciones tecnológicas, diseñar interfaces, definir la arquitectura, desarrollar, realizar pruebas exhaustivas, implementar y documentar todas las aplicaciones. Valoramos la autonomía, la creatividad, el criterio técnico y la capacidad de aportar mejoras significativas a las ideas originales. Se busca establecer una relación profesional de largo plazo para futuros desarrollos, mejoras y mantenimiento continuo. Es indispensable que el código fuente, los accesos y toda la documentación queden bajo la propiedad y el control de nuestra empresa. Categoría: Programación y Tecnología Subcategoría: Programación Web ¿Cuál es el alcance del proyecto?: Crear un nuevo sitio personalizado
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante: J. B. (Argentina). Publicó el anuncio en Workana (Hace 23 horas) con presupuesto de USD 250 - 500.
